title: What's a Mushroom Ring Doing in the Garden?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A perfect ring of small white mushrooms appears overnight in a villager's garden: step inside, or leave it alone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Overnight, a perfect ring of small white mushrooms has appeared in the middle of (name1)'s garden. A real circle, almost as wide as a hut, every mushroom the same size. Yesterday there was nothing there. (name1) stands at the edge of the ring, feeling as though (he/she) should knock before going in.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) steps into the middle of the ring. Nothing happens. Nothing at all. The birds sing, the breeze blows, (his/her) feet are still (his/her) feet. (name1) feels a little silly, and a little relieved, and a little disappointed, all at once. (He/She) steps out again carefully, without touching any of them, just in case.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) leaves the ring exactly as it is. (He/She) asks the elders about it. One says it's a sign of good soil. One says it's where the spirits danced last night. One says it's just mushrooms. (name1) thinks all three answers are nice. A few days later the mushrooms vanish as quietly as they came.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing, a sound or a worry disappears); nobody goes missing
